hook.name: BasedBidHook
hook.description: A Uniswap V4 hook that levies configurable hook fees (static, tiered, or dynamic with surge pricing) on each swap and distributes proceeds among LP liquidity, buybacks, rewards, and custom wallets. Supports whitelist-period buy limits, cooldown penalties for rapid repeat trades, and optional multi-hop fee conversion swaps to route revenue to reward tokens.
